question: Khuallam and Cheraw are the dance forms of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khuallam and Cheraw are dance forms from the state of Mizoram** 
 
• **Khuallam**
 
 
• The name translates to "**Dance of the Guests**".
 
• It is **performed by** guests at the Khuangchawi ceremony.
 
• The** performer sways a traditional Mizo cloth** wrapped around their shoulder. 
 
 
 
• **Cheraw**
 
 
• Also **known as the Bamboo Dance,** this is a traditional and famous dance of Mizoram.
 
• It is **performed by** six to eight people holding bamboo staves on another bamboo placed on the ground.
 
• The** dancers step in and out of the bamboo sticks **while dancing to the beat of drums and gongs.
 
• It is **often performed during special occasions**, such as when there is a **bumper harvest**. 
 
 
 
• **Other traditional dances of Mizoram include Sarlamkai, Chheihlam, and Mizo**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Manipur
 Thang Ta, Lai Haraoba, Pung Cholom, Rakhal, Nat Rash, Maha Rash, Raukhat, Dol Cholam, Khamba Thaibi, Nupa Dance, Raslila, Khubak Ishei, Lhou Sha
 
 

 Mizoram
 Cheraw Dance, Khuallam, Chailam, Sawlakin, Chawnglaizawn, Zangtalam, Par Lam, Sarlamkai/ Solakia, Tlanglam, Khanatm, Pakhupila, Cherokan
 
 

 Tripura
 Hozagiri
 
 

 Assam
 Bihu, Bichhua, Natpuja, Maharas, Kaligopal, Bagurumba, Naga dance, Khel Gopal, Tabal Chongli, Canoe, Jhumura Hobjanai etc
